name: Heading
summary: A heading, h1 to h6. The level picks both the element and the size, as in the reference library.

a11y.apg: Native h1–h6, so the level is the outline a screen reader navigates by. Keep levels in order on the page; do not skip one to get a smaller look.

props.name: level
props.description: The heading level: it renders h1…h6 and takes that role's size (4xl down to base, semibold, tight leading). There is no separate size prop, as in the reference library — the level is the design.

props.name: color
props.description: Two colours only, like the reference library: the text colour or the muted one. A closed list protects contrast — both pass AA on every Aurea surface.

props.name: weight
props.description: Overrides the weight of the role. Headings are semibold and body text is regular by default. "extrabold" (800, --weight-extrabold) since 0.28.0 (GAR-16), for a cover title; the default title weight is still semibold.

props.name: align
props.description: Text alignment. start and end follow the writing direction, so the same value mirrors in RTL.

props.name: truncate
props.description: One line, cut with an ellipsis. Turns the element into a block so the cut has a width to measure against.

props.name: numeric
props.description: GAR-16 (0.28.0): tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) — for numbers that line up in a column (price, year, spec sheet) or change on screen. Off by default: in running text the narrow "1" is right. Native: the same prop sets fontVariant ["tabular-nums"].
